messages:
Maya: quick heads-up from keyboard QA: the help sidecar opens from dashboards but it mutates the URL to a full docs URL and we lose Console state. users report losing filter selection. can we make links open the docs sidecar in-place (pushState) instead of navigating away?

Ken: yep that's happening because anchors are full hrefs to docs.site. we can intercept clicks and use history.pushState to set ?help=kv-cache and render the sidecar. simpler than proxying the whole docs.

Priya: while we do that, can we normalize the label? Console uses "Help" in some places, "Docs" in others, and the flyout title says "Reference". customers see 3 different words for the same thing. propose: call it "Docs" everywhere. shorter and consistent with marketing.

Diego: accessibility note: when the sidecar opens we need to: 1) trap focus, 2) set aria-hidden on background, 3) add aria-current on the highlighted anchor. also the heading should be announced with aria-live if deep-linked.

DocsBot: automation check: deep link mapping accepted. server can produce a redirect URL like /console/models/abc?openDocs=kv-cache and client will open sidecar and scroll to #kv-cache. recommended param name openDocs for clarity.

Maya: good. can we also keep the original element focused after close? previously keyboard users lost their place. simple save/restore of activeElement should do.

Ken: implementation plan: intercept internal docs clicks, call preventDefault, pushState, mount sidecar, save document.activeElement. on close call focusRestore.focus(). add a small requestAnimationFrame before focusing to avoid jump.

Priya: copy alignment: suggested microcopy for the top of the sidecar: "Docs: Quick reference and examples for Console features." short, consistent. update the global nav tooltip from "Help" -> "Docs" too.

Diego: visual nits: focus ring uses token --focus-ring which currently is too faint on our dark theme. contrast audit flagged 3.2:1 on the badge. switch badge bg to token --accent-600 and ensure 4.5:1.

DocsBot: test matrix: unit tests for pushState handler, e2e keyboard open/close with focus assertion, accessibility axe scan on staging.

Maya: PR branch: feature/docs-sidecar-pushstate. include changelog entry and migration note for any bookmarked full docs links.

Ken: deploying to staging after CI passes. will post staging link and a 10s screencap showing open/close focus flow.

Priya: product review: once staging link up I'll check copy across Console, docs.site, and tooltips. also will run a micro-survey in #beta for naming preference if folks want to weigh in.

Diego: QA checklist: keyboard trap, focus restore, aria-hidden background, aria-live for deep-link highlight, contrast tokens.

Maya: thanks all. tagging @eng-oncall for deploy window and @design for review on the updated badge colors. :sparkles:
